sections.Profile:
Seven Winner, produced by Inder in 1973, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a gambling and dice-playing theme. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, four mushroom bumpers, two slingshots, three standup targets, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1973
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Dice, Single Player, Gambling, Original Theme, 1970s
